The wait between the first two seasons of "Severance" has been long, and the third season also requires tremendous patience—but Apple TV has just released a noteworthy update on the show's progress.

"Severance" Season 3 has officially begun filming, and is expected to premiere in late 2027

It has been roughly 18 months since Season 2 of "Severance" first aired. Although the progress of Season 3 has not been ideal, it has just reached an important milestone.

According to the latest post on X by Ben Stiller, which was also reposted by the official Apple TV account, Season 3 of "Severance" has officially begun production.

The low-resolution production photo shared by Stiller appears to show Mark S. and Helly R. running down a Lumon corridor, echoing the imagery from the Season 2 finale.

Season 2 ended with Mark's shocking decision to stay by Helly's side and rebel against his "outie"—defying the plan to reunite with Gemma—setting up what is sure to be a string of gripping events for Season 3.

There was a three-year gap between Seasons 1 and 2 of "Severance," due to factors including script rewrites, reshoots, and the Hollywood strikes, among other issues.

If Season 3 has a production period of six to nine months, followed by approximately half a year of post-production, viewers will quite likely welcome the return of "Severance" in the fall of 2027—only a few months shorter than the three-year gap.

When do you predict Season 3 of "Severance" will premiere? Let us know in the comments section.

Apple TV's monthly subscription is US$12.99, and discounts are also available through the Apple One bundle.
